title: CodeGraph — shared graph output schema
description: Both the Python and JS/TS analyzers MUST emit exactly this shape. The backend merges two GraphResult objects and the frontend consumes one.

repo.description: Source GitHub URL that was analyzed

summary.description: Whole-graph plain-English summary. Empty until M6 enrichment runs.

NodeType.description: table=DB table/model, file=source file, function=plain function/method, component=React component, route=HTTP handler, service=external service (e.g. Supabase client)

EdgeKind.description: imports=file→file, calls=fn→fn, reads=fn/file→table (SELECT), writes=fn/file→table (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE), defines=file→fn/component/route, relation=table→table (FK)

NodeMeta.description: Node-type-specific extra data. All fields optional; consume only what applies to the node type.

exported.description: function / component nodes: whether the symbol is exported

params.description: function nodes: parameter names in declaration order

routePath.description: route nodes: URL path pattern, e.g. /api/users/[id]

Node.description: Node ID conventions (both analyzers MUST follow these): file → 'file:{rel/path}', table → 'table:{TableName}', function → 'fn:{rel/path}:{fnName}', component → 'component:{rel/path}:{Name}', route → 'route:{METHOD}:{path}', service → 'service:{name}'

id.description: Globally unique. See ID conventions in the parent description.

file.description: Relative path from repo root. Use empty string for nodes derived from a schema file that is itself already a node (e.g. a table inside schema.prisma).

line.description: 1-based line number where this node is defined, if known

description.description: One-sentence plain-English description. Empty until M6 enrichment.

line.description: 1-based line number of the reference in the source file, if known

nodeId.description: The node this warning refers to, if applicable
